description: Edwin's short summary and key features for products from an earlier Edwin result (search_products, recommend_product, find_alternatives, compare_products or get_offers), written from the merchants' product data, not from tests or reviews. Use it when the user asks what a product offers, what is included, or how the products differ. Where the merchant data states them, `facts` adds key figures per product (label and value, already in the requested language); an empty value means the product has that property.

lang.description: Language of the summary as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. de-DE, en, pt-BR: the language the user writes in.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the user's shopping market, e.g. DE, AT, NL, FR, GB, US. Infer from the user's context.

pids.description: Product ids from a previous Edwin tool result, at most eight.

name: get_product_text
title: Product summary and key features
